text: dsh-sourcebook 将本地 Sourcebook Desktop 资料库接入 DSH：它通过内置 MCP 客户端以 stdio 启动 sourcebook-mcp，并启用侧边栏浏览器。用户可查找资料、将选中的文件来源带入任务，或把文本和本地文件提交回资料库审核。适合跨会话复用研究资料的用户。需要在同一台 macOS 电脑安装 Sourcebook Desktop；默认命令使用标准应用路径。

dsh-sourcebook connects a local Sourcebook Desktop library to DSH through its built-in MCP client and enables the sidebar browser. Users can find sources, bring selected files into a task, and submit text or local files for library review. It requires Sourcebook Desktop on the same macOS computer.
我想让 DSH 搜索本地资料库里的项目参考资料。
怎样把选中的文件资料带进当前 DSH 任务作为上下文？
I want to keep useful DSH notes and drafts in my local research library for later sessions.
dsh-sourcebook 的功能「连接资料库」：通过 DSH 内置 MCP 客户端启动本地 Sourcebook helper，让用户查找资料并将选中的文件来源带入任务。

dsh-sourcebook README · Sourcebook for DSH：**Keep reusable research, working materials, and notes in Sourcebook across DSH sessions. Bring selected sources into a task, then hand useful work back for review.**
Use the DSH workspace for files in your current project. Use Sourcebook Books for references and materials you want to find again across projects: links, files, and notes stay organized in your local library.
dsh-sourcebook README · Sourcebook for DSH：

dsh-sourcebook README · Who it's for：- Video and visual content creators working from reference images, clips, links, and briefs
- Designers, writers, and researchers who reuse project research and working notes across deliverables
- People who move between DSH sessions or agents and want useful materials and notes to remain available afterward
For example, collect campaign references in a Book, ask DSH to draft a brief from selected sources, then submit the finished brief and its working notes back to Sourcebook for review.
This community bundle connects DSH's built-in MCP client directly to the sourcebook-mcp helper shipped with Sourcebook Desktop. It also enables DSH's built-in sidebar browser. There is no separate adapter service and no copied pairing credential.
> Independent community bundle; not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek. Sourcebook Desktop must be installed and running on the same computer as DSH.

dsh-sourcebook README · Bring sources into a task：- Open Sourcebook, check its local service, and choose a Book.
- Search that Book and retrieve the sources relevant to the current task.
- Prepare explicitly selected file sources as temporary context files. DSH can then read them through its normal workspace tools.
- Open HTTP(S) source links in DSH's built-in sidebar browser.

dsh-sourcebook README · Copying link-type sources：When Sourcebook is open in DSH's sidebar, it runs inside an iframe on a different origin from DSH. The sidebar currently does not grant that iframe clipboard-write permission, so copying a link-type source with Sourcebook's Copy button may fail with a Clipboard API or Permissions Policy error. To copy the link, open the same Sourcebook HTTP(S) address in a standalone browser tab and use Copy there, or select the URL text and press Command+C (macOS) or Ctrl+C. This is a limitation of the embedded browser's clipboard permissions; the plugin cannot change the iframe permission. File-source copy may use a different path and can continue to work.

dsh-sourcebook README · Hand useful work back：When DSH creates something worth keeping, ask it to propose new text, import a named local file, or update source metadata in a Book. The proposals appear in Sourcebook for you to accept or reject; the library changes only after you accept. New text and files can include a note about their origin or intended use, so the next session has context too.
For handoff to another agent, Sourcebook Desktop's **Pack** copies selected materials to the clipboard for pasting into that agent. Ongoing project materials and one-off tasks can stay organized in the same library.

dsh-sourcebook README · Try it：- “Open Sourcebook and find the references in my Launch Book for this project.”
- “Use the selected sources to draft a brief, then submit the final text to my Launch Book with a note about its purpose.”
- “Import this local file into my Launch Book and open Sourcebook so I can review the submission.”

dsh-sourcebook README · Requirements & install：**Requirements:** DeepSeek Harness with the built-in @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client, Sourcebook Desktop installed and running on the same computer, and macOS. The default helper path in this bundle targets the standard macOS app location.

**Download Sourcebook Desktop:** [macOS (Apple silicon) DMG — click to download](https://github.com/Yanze-He/sourcebook-for-agents/releases/download/v0.1.1-beta.6/sourcebook-desktop-installer-v0.1.1-beta.6.dmg)

dsh-sourcebook README · DSH Desktop：1. Open DSH Desktop and go to **Settings → Plugins → Add plugin**.
2. Enter the repository URL: https://github.com/Yanze-He/dsh-sourcebook, then complete the Add plugin flow.
3. Restart DSH. Start a new conversation and ask it to open Sourcebook and list your Books. DSH will launch Sourcebook Desktop and return a local HTTP(S) link; click it to open the app in DSH's sidebar browser.

dsh-sourcebook README · DSH Web profile：Run:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Yanze-He/dsh-sourcebook
For HTTP(S) links returned by Sourcebook to open in the sidebar browser, set DSH's **Link opening method** to **In-app sidebar**. Public and loopback HTTP(S) links are supported. The browser rejects file:, data:, blob:, and DSH's own origin.

dsh-sourcebook README · If Sourcebook is installed somewhere else：The bundled patch uses this standard macOS application path:
/Applications/Sourcebook Desktop.app/Contents/Resources/agent-plugin/.agents/plugins/sourcebook/bin/sourcebook-mcp
If your app is installed elsewhere, update the command value in cordis.patch.yml to the actual helper path, then install the local checkout into the DSH profile with:
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-sourcebook-plugin.
section: If Sourcebook is installed somewhere else
